verdict.rationale: AngelList's own docs show convertible notes held on the cap table and stakeholder dashboard, and a conversions tool that produces an Excel pro forma. Stakeholders can accept and e-sign issued instruments, and founders can launch and close rounds in-platform. However, conversion handling is documented as recording an already executed conversion, and nothing explicitly shows founders drafting and sending SAFEs or notes in-platform. The FAQ about moving customers to J.P. Morgan and Pulley also leaves the offering's continuity uncertain. Missing for 10: explicit in-platform SAFE/convertible note creation and sending, documented e-sign flow specific to SAFEs/notes, conversion terms (cap, discount) modeled live on the cap table, independent corroboration.
